basic_details.post_name: Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System) and Associate (Mechanical)

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL), 10 years for PwD Gen, 15 years for PwD SC/ST, 13 years for PwD OBC(NCL). | To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

qualification.details: Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System): Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech) with a Master's in Business Administration (MBA) / Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) from a recognized University / Institute. Minimum 5-10 years (FT-M3) or above 10 years (FT-M4) post-qualification experience in commercial/procurement/sales/supply chain with minimum 3 years in public procurement through government e-procurement portals. Associate (Mechanical): Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) from a recognized University / Institute. Minimum 5-10 years post-qualification experience in manufacturing industries. Desirable: Boiler Operation Engineer (BOE) certification.

salary_details.details: Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System): Rs. 1,00,000/- or Rs. 1,20,000/- per month. Associate (Mechanical): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month.

selection_process: Personal Interview Group Discussion Written Test
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NRL Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NRL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Numaligarh Refinery recruitment is 13th October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the closing date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System), a B.E./B.Tech with MBA/PGDM is required. For Associate (Mechanical), a B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for NRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NRL Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 50 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, OBC(NCL), and PwD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available in NRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by Numaligarh Refinery for the Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System) and Associate (Mechanical) positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these NRL jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Numaligarh Refinery recruitment includes a Written Test, Group Discussion, and a Personal Interview. Candidates must clear all stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the positions at Numaligarh Refinery?
faq.answer: The job type for the Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System) and Associate (Mechanical) positions at Numaligarh Refinery is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Numaligarh Refinery located?
faq.answer: Numaligarh Refinery is located in Numaligarh, Assam. The recruitment is specifically for candidates in this state.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these contractual roles?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for Associate (Mechanical) and Rs. 1,00,000/- or Rs. 1,20,000/- per month for Associate (Commercial System) / Sr. Associate (Commercial System).

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Assam apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Assam. It is advisable to check the official notification for specific eligibility regarding the state of residence.
